decoration_notice.text: Saltlow went inland in the autumn and took everything that would carry. Its barrels and chests stand empty now; only what was left on purpose is still here.

npc/ansel.doing: waiting at the head of the quay steps with one eye on the tide, for the carriers his letter sent for
watching the carriers come back down the street with his sister's parcel, the mooring rope already in his hand

happening.subject: npc/ansel
happening.text: Carriers come down the cart road into Saltlow, answering the ferryman's letter.

happening.subject: npc/ansel
happening.text: Ansel asks the carriers to fetch his sister's parcel from her house.

objectives.hint: Walk down the street to the man waiting on the quay at the far end.
objectives.title: Find the ferryman

happening.subject: item/marras-parcel
happening.text: The carriers take Marra's parcel from the chest at the foot of her bed.

objectives.hint: With Ansel behind you, walk up the street: Marra's is the first door on your right. The chest is at the foot of her bed.
objectives.title: Fetch Marra's parcel

happening.subject: npc/ansel
happening.text: The carriers bring the parcel to Ansel at the quay.

objectives.hint: Take the parcel back down the street to Ansel on the quay.
objectives.title: Bring the parcel to Ansel

happening.subject: npc/ansel
happening.text: Ansel sails from Saltlow with the parcel and the carriers aboard.
